LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO SOCIAL ENTREPRENEURSHIP

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
Strand: Social Entrepreneurship
Topic 4.1: Introduction to Social Entrepreneurship
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Introduction to Social Entrepreneurship, part of Social Entrepreneurship in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING.

Key inquiry question: How can social entrepreneurship promote the welfare of a community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Introduction to Social Entrepreneurship together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration enhanced as the learner speaks clearly and engagingly while reflecting on

benefits of social entrepreneurship in the community

● Digital literacy is promoted as the learner uses digital devices to search differences between social enterprise and

other enterprises.

Values:
Respect is nurtured as the learner respects divergent opinions while discussing the concept of social entrepreneurship.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Online safety is enhanced as the learner observes online safety while searching using digital devices on the

differences between social enterprise and other enterprises.
